name: Glazed Cottage Roll
description: A sweet and savory glazed cottage roll baked with a mustard and brown sugar crust.

recipeInstructions.text: Remove outer wrapper from cottage roll. Place in large saucepan and cover with water. Add bay leaf, cloves, garlic and onion.
Bring to a boil, cover pan and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 1½ to 2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 170°F (75°C).
Lift meat from water and remove netting. Place in shallow pan or casserole dish.
Blend mustard and brown sugar together. Spread over cottage roll.
Bake in 425°F (220°C) oven for 15 minutes, basting occasionally, until glaze is set.

keywords: glazed cottage roll, baked ham, sweet glaze

_similar.name: Sliced Ham
_similar.description: A simple baked ham recipe with a brown sugar, mustard, and allspice topping.
recipeIngredient: 6 slices ham, about ½ inch thick

recipeInstructions.text: Place ham slices on a cookie sheet.
Mix brown sugar, dry mustard, and allspice together. Sprinkle over ham slices.
Bake in 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes, turning once and sprinkling additional mixture on the other side.

_similar.keywords: baked ham, glazed ham, sweet ham

_similar.name: Cottage Cheese Jellied Salad
_similar.description: A light and fruity salad made with cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts, set in a gelatin mold.
recipeIngredient: 3 oz package orange or lemon flavored gelatin

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add mayonnaise and whisk to blend.
Chill until the mixture starts to set.
Add cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts. Combine well.
Pour the mixture into a clear glass bowl or a 4-cup lightly oiled mold.

_similar.keywords: cottage cheese salad, jellied salad, pineapple salad

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: ham casserole, potato casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple and customizable veggie pizza using crescent rolls as the crust, topped with a cream cheese mixture and various vegetables.
recipeIngredient: Veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery, red or green peppers, green onions)

recipeInstructions.text: Roll out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and a small cake pan. Bake until golden brown. Cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and ranch dressing to make the cream mixture.
Spread cream mixture on cooled rolls.
Top with finely chopped vegetables of your choice.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Chill and cut into small pieces. Serve as hors d'oeuvres.

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple veggie pizza made with a crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing, and various chopped vegetables.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup finely chopped green or red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll out crescent roll dough on a flat cookie sheet.
Bake until golden brown.
Mix cream cheese with ranch dressing.
Spread the cream cheese mixture onto the cooled crust.
Top with chopped vegetables.
Keep refrigerated before serving.
Cut with pizza cutter or knife.

_similar.keywords: veggie pizza, crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing
